subject.title: fix: harden web fetch HTML conversion [AI]

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's changed malformed-HTML fallback and SDK-exported cleanup-helper semantics as the web_fetch compatibility tradeoff?
rationale: The patch changes a shipped user-facing fallback renderer and exported helper behavior, and tests cannot decide whether output drift for existing malformed pages or plugins is acceptable.

options.title: Require proof, then accept bounded scanner
options.body: Keep the scanner direction if the contributor adds real web_fetch proof and maintainers accept small output drift for malformed fallback pages and SDK helper consumers.

options.title: Narrow the parser hardening
options.body: Ask for a smaller change that removes the vulnerable broad replacements while preserving more legacy fallback output and helper behavior.

options.title: Pause for extraction consolidation
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want the adjacent title-only fallback work to define the shared raw-cleanup parser direction first.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then accept bounded scanner
